items.title: Tom Lellis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, July 31, 2007
items.q: There was a great tune by Victor Feldman, “Azule Serape.”

ctx.x: I think, plus his tone was, I mean as a saxophone player it’s like well there you go.

There you go. And he used the Latin thing and he expanded, he was a big influence as far as my Latin thing, you know. There was a great tune by Victor Feldman, “Azule Serape.” Oh, what a great tune, knocked me down, loved it.
Wow. Yup. Well here’s a — I don’t think I’ve ever asked this question of anybody but I’ll try it out on you. Do you believe in any kind of reincarnation?
